rows.en: Growster: "...I see... Grad has been defeated..."
Adjutant: "Major Burgley charged into Flamuelk Castle alone.
His fate is currently unknown."
Growster: "..."
Adjutant: "Your Excellency...?"
Growster: "Why? Why would a man of his caliber
do something so reckless...?"
Adjutant: "That has been troubling me as well.
I have people investigating it now, but Captain Falmore
appears to be involved."
Growster: "Steinies.
I did entrust him with negotiating Grad's return, but..."
Adjutant: "This has not yet been substantiated either,
but it seems he made the safety of Major Burgley's wife and daughter
a condition of his return."
Growster: "!! Outrageous!
Damn him! A soldier of the glorious Zigrim Army,
laying hands on women and children... The shameless bastard!
Bring Steinies here!
I'll beat that rotten character out of him!"
Adjutant: "Y-Your Excellency, please calm yourself.
We do not yet have conclusive proof..."
Growster: "You would never bring me unreliable information!
That means this is almost certainly true.
Now, where is he?"
Adjutant: "Well... At present, he is on 'exclusive Type Three duty,'
or so I am told..."
Growster: "Type Three?!
Presidential orders... Grr, that useless fool.
Just what is he planning...?"
Horem: "...My apologies. I seem to have kept you waiting."
Tyron: "Not at all."
Horem: "Have you recovered now?
Armored Mechs may have excellent pilot protection systems,
but to have survived those circumstances...
No one expected to find you inside the mech
we brought back for research and analysis. The doctor who examined you
was amazed. Said you had extraordinary vitality."
Tyron: "Thanks to you, I have survived to stand here today.
I am grateful."
Horem: "...Now, now. You mustn't say things you don't mean."
Tyron: "..."
Horem: "Well, never mind.
There is only one reason I have called you back today.
As for the life of York's Ciel Ren Vratzen,
I want you to take it."
Tyron: "Th-That is..."
Horem: "Does it seem strange? That I should go out of my way to target
a mere knight, however capable? But to all of you,
she is more than just a knight, isn't she?"
Tyron: "Y-You are..."
Horem: "Just a public servant.
I merely possess a little 'power' that others do not."
Tyron: "Power?"
Horem: "Yes. For example, I know you are trying to probe the force behind Zigrim,
to discover the true identity of ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Tyron: "!!"
Horem: "Curious, isn't it?
How do I know something you have never told anyone?"
Tyron: "Can you... read people's minds...?"
Horem: "Who knows? Let me tell you one last interesting thing.
This invasion of York was my proposal.
I also planned Queen Alforina's assassination.
Unfortunately, that attempt failed. Still, although circumstances were beyond my control,
someone else succeeded, so in the end,
everything turned out as I intended."
Tyron: "It was you...!!"
Horem: "Well, now you have no regrets left, do you?
I am counting on you to provide some valuable sample data..."
Tyron: "What are you saying... Urgh!
Y-You... What have you... Gah!"
Horem: "Hehehehe... It's a 'drug.'
A magic drug that creates the perfect soldier...
Now, allow me to grant you the honor
of becoming the first test subject..."
Tyron: "S-Stop... Sto..."
Horem: "Oh... You're putting up quite a fight...
I suppose I should expect no less.
Oh dear. But it seems this is as far as you can go..."
Tyron: "..."
Horem: "Hmm? A bell? Oh, what an elegant little thing...
You may have no need for it as you are now,
but I shall return it to you."
Tyron: "..."
Horem: "Well then, off you go.
Oh, and if you are captured, kill yourself.
It would cause all sorts of difficulties otherwise..."
Grad: "I'm sorry... I don't know how to thank you..."
Ai: "Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not doing this for you.
I'm doing it for your wife and daughter."
Grad: "Yes, I understand.
...Thank you."
Ai: "H-Hmph!"
Ymir: "Mr. Grad, shouldn't you be resting...?"
Grad: "No, there is something I would like to tell you."
Ymir: "?"
Grad: "Do you know why York
was really invaded?"
Ymir: "Mr. Grad, surely you shouldn't
be telling us something like that?"
Grad: "Please, do not concern yourself with me...
This invasion began at President Nell Horem's
suggestion. Its objective was to seize York's summoning facility
and either the Spirit Mechs themselves or their data.
Initially, there was opposition in parliament as well,
but the representatives who had vehemently opposed it
suddenly did an about-face and supported the president.
The proposal passed.
It was a clear violation of international conventions,
and a war of pure aggression.
I could not accept this deployment either.
Though it was precisely because the deployment had been approved
that I was recalled..."
Bernst: "So they did intend to use the summoning facility
to exploit people like Touya?"
Ymir: "But the facility..."
Grad: "Yes. When they learned that it was linked to the Holy Land
and could not be activated on its own,
they seem to have been disappointed."
Ai: "To think they started a war over something so petty..."
Grad: "There are no just reasons for war.
There is only each side's self-serving notion of justice.
Nor can I claim justice when I accept its benefits."
Fain: "No! You are different, Lord Grad!"
Grad: "Heh... You think too highly of me.
I even misjudged that president's true nature."
Celica: "So his reputation as a useless fool was..."
Grad: "Probably a deliberate act until his preparations were complete.
His eyes were like an abyss shrouded in darkness,
into which no one could peer...
I cannot put it well, but I sensed a greed in him
that would swallow not only Zigrim, but Agarthia itself.
General Growster feels the same way.
I also hear that Steinies has some connection
with the president."
Celica: "That president, of all people...
We'll have to look into him properly..."
Ai: "Let's think about what's in front of us instead of the future.
We're nearly there, aren't we?
Shouldn't we start getting ready?"
Ymir: "You're right. Now then, Touya... Huh?"
Ai: "? I thought he was being awfully quiet.
Where did he go?"
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "Kasumi."
Kasumi: "Oh... Touya-chan...
...How did you know I was here?"
I just had a feeling.
I thought this was where you'd be, Kasumi.
Kasumi: "It's strange. That you'd come, Touya-chan...
I had that feeling too."
Touya: "Y-You did...?"
Kasumi: "You've always been like that. Whenever I was feeling down
or worried about something, you'd always find me...
You'd always come to me, just like this..."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Kasumi: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "Well, actually..."
Yamato: "The reason we knew Kasumi was here
is that I told him, meow."
Kasumi: "Huh? You did, Yamato-chan?"
Touya: "Gabon went and gave her a function that detects people's brainwaves
and uses them to find where they are.
I can't exactly tell where you are in this world on my own."
Kasumi: "I see."
Yamato: "Sorry. Come on, you apologize too, meow."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... I'm sorry.
I wasn't trying to fool you.
You were so honestly happy to see me that, well..."
Kasumi: "It's all right.
I'm just happy you came, Touya-chan."
Touya: "Y-You did...?"
Kasumi: "Yes."
Yamato: "Oh my. Am I getting in the way, perhaps?"
Kasumi: "Huh? Not at all.
You came because you were worried too, didn't you, Yamato-chan?
Thank you."
Yamato: "You're welcome.
But are you all right?"
Kasumi: "Yes. I'm still confused, but I'm all right.
Everyone really is amazing. As for me, even though I thought
I understood this wasn't a game,
I got shaken up and lost my composure so easily..."
Touya: "You can't help it. Even I have to force myself to accept
some of this. Back in our own world, we'd never
experienced war, and death wasn't always right beside us.
Killing someone was something that happened on TV."
Kasumi: "Yes. Are you scared too, Touya-chan?"
Touya: "Well, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't.
But if my fighting can save someone,
then I intend to fight."
Kasumi: "You really are amazing.
I'm scared..."
Yamato: "Kasumi, maybe you shouldn't pilot a Spirit Mech after all..."
Encourage Kasumi.
Say nothing.
Touya: "Kasumi. If you let fear take over, you won't see anything else.
If you run away, nothing will change.
I think it's worth trying to face it head-on."
Yamato: "Touya?!"
Kasumi: "...You're right.
I'm always running away... Maybe that's why
I never get anywhere."
Touya: "..."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan. Do you think I can do it?
Do you think I can be useful?"
Touya: "That's up to you, Kasumi. But I think you can."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... I'll try my best.
I might end up causing trouble for you again. Is that all right?"
Touya: "If you're okay with me, I'll help as much as you need."
Kasumi: "Yes... Thank you."
Kasumi: "...But I do think I can't just keep
running away. If I stopped piloting a Spirit Mech now,
I might never have to feel scared like this again.
But then I'd worry about you and everyone else getting hurt, Touya-chan.
I'd be so anxious I wouldn't know what to do.
So I want to stay as close to everyone as I can,
and help however I can..."
Touya: "Kasumi..."
Kasumi: "I might cause trouble for you again. Is that all right?"
Touya: "If you're okay with me, I'll help as much as you need."
Kasumi: "Yes... Thank you."
Yamato: "Oh! Isn't it about time we arrived, meow?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah, you're right. Okay, let's get back to the bridge."
Kasumi: "Um... Touya-chan..."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Kasumi: "...No, it's nothing. Let's go."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Miyasco: "Prana signature confirmed! It's an Armored Mech!"
Grad: "Did we make it in time?!"
Miyasco: "...Identification complete! It's a Griol!
It's definitely our target!"
Sisk: "Cornel Village is already just a stone's throw away.
We only just made it."
Aurelie: "We can't relax yet.
If it gets into the village, we won't be able to touch it.
We'll have to take it down before it gets there!"
Derock: "Then we can use the Epsion Cannon..."
Derock: "O-Ow!"
Clovis: "Doesn't your brain get any nourishment?
Can't you see what a disaster it'd be
if we fired that thing here?"
Derock: "O-Of course I know that.
I was just trying to lighten the mood.
It was a sophisticated joke..."
Celica: "All right, everyone, sortie!"
Clovis: "Right."
Touya: "All right, let's go!"
Derock: "...You must never forget your sense of humor, no matter the circumstances."
Sisk: "Yours isn't funny."
Derock: "Tsk, tsk, tsk... You've still got a long way to go.
You need to study a little more."
Miyasco: "Sisk, there's no point saying anything to him.
He's already living in his own self-contained world."
Derock: "Nfwoo~ Gyof, gyof..."
Sisk: "...So it seems."
